name: Do I need a punch list for small renovation projects in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a punch list for small renovation projects in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even for small renovation projects in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, a punch list is highly recommended. It provides a formal record of any remaining items or deficiencies, ensuring that all aspects of the project are completed to your satisfaction. This helps avoid misunderstandings and protects both the homeowner and the contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a punch list is recommended for small renovation projects to ensure all work is completed to your satisfaction.
